description: The deliberately-wrong case: the proof that a broken case fails the run. Not part of cases.json on purpose — it must never be scored as part of a real run.

cases.why: Stage 13's definition of done asks for a case proven able to fail the run, not merely assumed to be. This one asserts a ticket that was never created and a tool that was never called, so a suite that reported it as passing would be measuring nothing.
